description:
Your camera roll remembers where you went. Kindling helps you remember what it felt like.

Choose photos from a past trip and Kindling turns them into an editable Memory Trail—moments, places, notes, a map, and the small details ordinary photo libraries leave behind.

Built for memories without the blank journal page:
• Select only the photos and videos you want
• Automatically group them into editable moments
• Revisit the trip through a visual trail and memory map
• Add an optional note, private tag, Spark, or voice memory
• Find trips later by place, detail, or return intent
• Create privacy-previewed postcards and map cards
• Receive optional Postcards From Your Past

Kindling works without an account. It keeps protected, optimized copies on this iPhone so saved trails remain available offline. Photos, coordinates, notes, voice recordings, and search text are never sent to analytics.

Your first two saved trips are free. Kindling Pro unlocks unlimited trails, premium sharing styles, branding controls, and expanded resurfacing controls.

Kindling does not plan travel, provide navigation, or make medical claims.

promotionalText: Choose an old trip and turn scattered photos into a private, interactive memory trail.
